reason: Automates ensuring and rotating a DeepSeek Harness web server, including detached startup, port-based process termination, launcher file creation, and flag-triggered restarts.

summaries.zh: 用于自动确保 DeepSeek Harness Web 服务运行，并通过脱管进程和标记文件触发安全重启。
summaries.en: Automates ensuring and rotating a DeepSeek Harness web server through detached process startup and flag-triggered restarts.

capabilities: Starts a detached DeepSeek Harness web server process
Restarts the web server and terminates the process listening on the configured port
Creates launcher and rotation command files in DSH_HOME
Executes PowerShell WMI process creation and detached process spawning
Uses a flag file to trigger a service restart
